summary:
Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword rules under src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with matching unit-test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Nothing committed.

Test results: the new modules and existing ECS tests plus test_rules_collections.py pass (91 tests). test/unit/rules and test/unit/module (excluding formatters) give 1533 passed and 1 failure, test_build_graph, which needs pygraphviz/pydot and is missing from the venv. test/unit/module/formatters could not be collected because defusedxml is missing. test_good_templates and test_integration_templates pass (3 tests).

Caveats: the venv's editable cfnlint points at a different base/ tree, so I ran with this checkout's src on PYTHONPATH and did not modify the venv. Black and ruff are not installed in the venv; I checked the 88-column limit by hand only. I removed a generic.yaml.dot artifact that the integration run wrote into test/fixtures.

Design choices: E3052 emits at most one error per service/task-definition pair; Ref AWS::NoValue counts as absent; the reference resolver is duplicated across E3052 and E3054 rather than shared; bool values are not treated as ports.
